name: Maadi Law, LLC
verdict: The biggest movement this period is a 366.67% surge in leads week-over-week (18 leads over 28 days, with the recent 7-day window driving the spike), likely fueled by the top Local Services campaign absorbing $1,677.52 of the $2,861.12 total spend while cost-per-lead dropped 79.68% to $158.95. GBP contributed 26 calls and 121 total actions, though GBP interactions fell 58% in the last 7 days, worth monitoring as a potential early softening signal.

performance.verdict: Leads are arriving but 5 overdue SOW milestones still block signed-case measurement.

findings.text: 5 SOW milestones overdue since July 31–Aug 1: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting — all unconfirmed as complete.
CPL dropped 79.68% to $158.95 over 7d, driven by 18 Meta leads; but Google Ads logged 0 GHL-tracked conversions vs. $2,120.45 spend — attribution is broken, not zero leads.
3-day signal (Sep 11–13): leads averaged 2.0/day vs 1.67/day prior 3 days — modest upward trend, but spend is volatile (Sep 11: $196.79, Sep 12: $147.65, Sep 13: $167.21), not yet stable.
GHL shows 72 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments — 18 tracked leads vs. 72 opps suggests intake pipeline is inflated or leads are stalling pre-consult.
GBP actions fell 58% in last 7 days; last 2 series days show 0 GBP actions (Sep 12–13), following a prior 45-day average of ~4.3 actions/day — early softening, not yet confirmed.

suggestions.text: Fix Google Ads conversion tracking — $2,120.45 spent with 0 GHL-attributed conversions; install and verify pixel before next spend cycle.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has consumed $2,120.45 in the 28-day window with zero conversions recorded in GHL, indicating a broken or missing conversion event. The SOW milestone 'Pre-Launch Stack Test Passed' (due July 31) and conversion tracking setup are both unresolved — these must be completed together. Success is confirmed when at least one test lead fires a conversion event visible in both Google Ads and GHL. Target completion: 2026-09-18.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL pipeline: 72 opportunities vs. 18 tracked leads and 0 appointments signals an intake or routing failure, not an ads volume problem.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 72 opportunities created against only 18 tracked leads and 0 booked appointments in the 28-day window. This gap suggests leads are entering the pipeline but not being routed, contacted, or converted to consults — an intake process failure, not an ads issue. Review lead routing rules, speed-to-lead timing, and whether 'opportunity' creation is being triggered by non-lead events. Success is confirmed when opportunity count aligns within 10% of tracked leads and appointments > 0 within 7 days.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP: 0 actions on Sep 12–13 after a 4.3/day average; re-check Sep 17 before treating as a confirmed drop.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP recorded 0 actions on the last 2 available series days (Sep 12–13), against a prior 45-day average of approximately 4.3 actions/day and a 7-day delta of -58%. This is hypothesis-grade — two days is not a confirmed signal. No action is warranted yet. Re-check on 2026-09-17: if GBP actions remain at or near 0 for a 5-day consecutive stretch, escalate to a profile audit.
